<function name="SelectPanel" parent="DPanelSelect" type="panelhook">
	<description>Selects a given panel.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pnl" type="Panel">Panel to select. It should've been added previously via <page>DPanelSelect:AddPanel</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
